introHtml: For medical facilities, 10 oz cups and mugs offer a practical, manageable size for patient hydration and staff breaks. Perfect for imprinting your clinic or hospital logo, they serve as functional giveaways for health fairs or employee recognition. Choose from durable materials like ceramic or insulated thermal options to suit your needs.
